title: Answer fake GitHub reads without a process per call

intentCoverage.report:
**Caught.** Maintained proof catches loss of fake API interception on the ordinary default request-owner path. The actual catch is the earlier exact-argv/provider-call assertion at `dashboard/backend-tests/runtime/fake-gh-in-process.spec.ts:28`; the later no-process assertions were not reached in the faulted run.

Story: `SEED-332#answer-fake-gh-reads-in-process`, supplied current amended `.planning/seeds/SEED-332-answer-fake-gh-in-process.md`, plan 610. Selected completed implementation: `b161cf65a957ff0538ff291d6e52a61328eb62b6`. Promise checked: ordinary simulated API reads use the already-running owner without a per-read API subprocess and preserve exact argv/binary answers. This one path does not assess loaded timing or every native control.

Used isolated detached scratch checkout `/tmp/s332-ic-q1w55o84/w` at that revision. Its only initial untracked entry was an owned `node_modules` symlink to existing dependencies. Installed test-entry selection resolved the maintained backend source to MakeMe=true, pageObjects=false. Existing fixture construction and deliberate wire bytes remained unchanged. Failure policy: root `AGENTS.md#failing-and-flaky-tests`, as written. Runs retained the default 30-second case timeout, zero retries and one worker, on AC under `caffeinate -s -i`; no generated contention or broad suite ran.

The focused command, unchanged across baseline/fault/restored, was:

```sh
caffeinate -s -i npm run test:dashboard -- dashboard/backend-tests/runtime/fake-gh-in-process.spec.ts --grep 'the real owner receives exact argv and binary stdout without a call PID' --workers=1
```

Each run set its own `OPEN_DOUGH_DASHBOARD_PROOF_RECORD` outside disposable outputs and `TMPDIR=/tmp/s332-ic-q1w55o84/t`. An initial anchored grep selected zero tests; it was corrected before the passing baseline and before any fault. That invocation supplied no baseline evidence.

The single fault changed `dashboard/tests/support/fakeGhPreload.mjs` from selecting `args?.[0] === "api"` to selecting `"__disabled_api__"`. This plausible interception regression sends API execution through native `execFile`. The unchanged `inProcessFixture` uses default `installFakeGh(root)` and its existing poisoned API executable, which writes `api-launched` containing `poison` and exits 99. Auth remains native.

Baseline selected and passed exactly one maintained case. With the fault, that same case failed its line-28 exact-argv assertion: expected one API call including `--include` and the supplied Unicode/header argv; received `[]`. No unrelated failure occurred.

Separately, a standalone scratch witness used the same `inProcessFixture`, exact argv and binary response input while the fault was installed. It observed transport=`in-process`, actual API subprocess marker=true with bytes `poison`, zero fake-provider calls, and an empty failed answer. This demonstrates wrong behavior on the intended default owner-read path, independently of the maintained assertion. Its fixture and owner root were absent after close, and its recorded owner PID was gone.

Restoration ran in a `finally` block with interruption handlers. Source bytes and SHA-256 (`57e688059cc8639a7124749126200f011fc81667b20e07fbe278b88c8f175a32`), full tracked diff, untracked status and dependency link matched their pre-probe state. The restored command selected and passed the same one case. A final comparison after that pass also matched. No scratch-checkout processes remained. The owned worktree, registration, dependency link, temporary fixtures and transform/compile caches were removed; root source, branch, index and observer were untouched.

**Next proof action:** retain the existing exact-argv and poisoned-executable proof for this path. This probe supports no added assertion or test repair. Plan 610 already intended the poisoned-executable contract; recognizing that existing catch creates no new repair decision. The coordinator's separate loaded/full/CI acceptance remains outside this check.

Report saved at `/tmp/seed332-final-intent-coverage-report.md`. Raw proof records, failure output/trace, witness, fault diff, restoration and cleanup evidence remain in `/tmp/seed332-final-ic-evidence-g6kz2byi/`.
